resources.string: Shows while Live AI Reply is watching for new messages. Use Stop to switch it off.
Reads the chat on screen so Live AI Reply can draft a reply.

Live AI Reply uses this service to read the conversation that is currently open in another chat app, to find the message input box, and to type a reply you have approved. It never reads password or PIN fields, it skips banking and authenticator apps, and it stops immediately when you press STOP AI. Nothing is recorded; the text is only sent to the AI endpoint you configure.
